title: Circle and Rectangle Overlapping
goal: Decide whether a circle and axis-aligned rectangle overlap or touch.
strategy: The closest rectangle point is obtained by clamping each center coordinate to its interval. Squared-distance comparison avoids square roots and includes tangency.
